briefdescription.para: TabbedComponent with ValueTree state, owns Attachments for child Panes.

detaileddescription.para: Inherits jam::TabbedComponent for tab strip and content management. Each tab's content component is an end::Panes instance, owned by TabbedComponent (deleteComponentWhenNotNeeded = true). Each Panes child has a corresponding jam::Model::Attachment held in tabAttachments — RAII ensures detach on removal.
Listens to the config ValueTree so that bar depth re-computes whenever the theme tab tree changes (depth, font_size, font_family).
